data.body: **P2 — Avoid the remaining plain-sampler preflight call.** For an undecided complete remote parent, this still invokes the visible plain sampler with `Workflow` before the real `Invocation` and `Workflow` spans invoke it again. Stateful or quota-based samplers consequently consume an extra decision and can record a different span set. Remove this preflight for plain replacements or make its result authoritative for the SDK spans, and update the remote-parent stateful-sampler test to expect only real-span evaluations.
